Subject: Sponsorship freight — drayage booking & customs hold

Hi all,

Quick heads up: our palletized sponsorship kit for Booth B12 (EventWorks Media) is listed on FastLine booking #FL-8742 and arrived at the port last night, but Pier7 reports the shipment is being held by customs for missing paperwork. We have a show arrival window: advance warehouse delivery by 03/06 and on-site drayage pickup 03/07 (setup 03/08).

Immediate asks:
- Andres: can you confirm what specific doc the broker needs to clear this? FastLine says they were missing a commercial invoice and a broker code.
- Pier7 / FastLine: please pause any return to origin; we want this routed to Pier7 for manifesting if you can accept it.
- Dev / Tessa: I need a single point of contact for signature on release forms and any last-minute customs payments.

Attachments: pro forma bill-of-lading stub (Bill_of_Lading_8742.pdf) attached.

This is a hard date for the sponsorship install — we need customs cleared by EOD 03/04 to keep the plan intact. Please reply with next steps.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Events Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Andrés Soto <andres.soto@clearancepros.co>

Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Sponsorship freight — drayage booking & customs hold

Hi Marissa / team,

Thanks for the note. I pulled the hold file — customs flagged the shipment for an incomplete commercial invoice and missing consignee EORI/CBP filer reference. To clear, I need the following from EventWorks:

1) Completed commercial invoice (value per item, HS codes, country of origin).
2) Consignee tax ID or EORI (for EU trade) or CBP filer number for US entries.
3) Any vendor invoices if value differs from shipper declaration.

I attached a blank commercial invoice template and a short checklist. If you can fill and return the invoice today I can submit the entry as a "release on bond" to speed it — there may be a small fee (~USD 250) for expedited processing.

I can also liaise directly with FastLine for the entry if you want me to take point. Please confirm authorization and preferred billing.

Best,
Andrés Soto
ClearancePros — Customs Broker
Phone: +1 (212) 555-0199
---
